entities.name: Query RlmN protein
observations: 358 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 40.4 kDa and pI 8.51.
Homologous to reviewed bacterial RlmN proteins with 44.4–46.2% identity and 93.3–96.9% query coverage.
Contains Pfam RlmN_N (PF21016) at residues 9–67 and Radical_SAM (PF04055) at residues 112–271.
Sequence contains a Cys-rich region consistent with binding a catalytic [4Fe–4S] cluster and a conserved terminal catalytic cysteine region characteristic of RlmN chemistry.
Likely a cytoplasmic dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase; exact substrate usage is inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Catalyzes C2 methylation of A2503 in 23S rRNA and A37 in tRNA.
Uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine and a catalytic [4Fe–4S] cluster; RlmN chemistry proceeds through a covalent S-methylcysteine intermediate.
Localized in the cytoplasm in reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: RlmN A2503 methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 2503 in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine (m2A2503), with S-adenosyl-L-methionine as methyl donor and 5'-deoxyadenosine plus S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine among the products in the mapped radical-SAM reaction representation.

entities.name: RlmN A37 methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 37 in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine (m2A37), with S-adenosyl-L-methionine as methyl donor and 5'-deoxyadenosine plus S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine among the products in the mapped radical-SAM reaction representation.
